title: Dell security advisory (AV26-966)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-966 Date: September 28, 2026 As of September 24, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Rugged Control Center (RCC) Prior to 5.2.206 Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Policy Manager Prior to 5.36.00.16 ThinOS 10 Prior to SecurityAddon_2605.10.2766_T10 Dell Trusted Device Client Prior to 8.1.359.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. DSA-2026-410: Security Update for Dell Rugged Control Center (RCC) Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-385: Security Update for Dell Secure Connect Gateway Policy Manager Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-404: Security Update for Dell ThinOS 10 for Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-408: Security Update for Dell Trusted Device Client for an Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource Vulnerability Security Advisories, Notices and Resources Article Link: Dell security advisory (AV26-966) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
